agentNote.body:
Ashley — an update on 695 Feather. Your close of escrow is now Friday, August 28. The extension is fully signed: you signed it August 12 and the seller signed it back on August 14, so this is final, not pending. Your price is unchanged at $170,000.

On funding: the home equity line your father signed on Monday is what we're now waiting on, and those funds are expected at escrow this Friday, August 21. Your loan contingency runs to August 25, which gives us a few days' cushion if the bank is slow. If you hear anything from them about timing, tell me the same day — that date is the one thing standing between here and closing.

The HOA documents that held things up earlier are resolved. Orange Coast sent the full Copper Cove package through on August 13 — CC&Rs, bylaws, the budget and reserve study, and the current board minutes. They're in your file to read through.

One thing to take care of now: complete your ClosingLock wire instructions, and call to verify them by phone before you send any funds. Never wire from instructions you received only by email.

— James Beyersdorf, (209) 770-7523
